Here we describe how you can estimate the false discovery rate (FDR) when matching your spectra against a FASTA sequence database using spectra search engines such as Mascot or Comet. The sequence database contains forward sequences and the same number of reverse sequences.

## The data

Comet's E-value significantly outperforms SEQUEST's probability score and Comet's cross-correlation score.


```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
library(dplyr)
library(prozor)
library(ggplot2)

data(bcd)
bcd |>
  mutate(hit = if_else(grepl("^REV_", protein), "decoy", "target")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(e.value), y = sp_score, colour = hit)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(target = "#0072B2", decoy = "#D55E00")) +
  labs(x = "-log10(E-value)", y = "Sp score", colour = NULL)
bcd |>
  select(scan, plain_peptide, protein, e.value, sp_score) |>
  head() |>
  knitr::kable()
```



# Define helper function

```{r}
summarizeLevel <- function(data, level = "PSM", score = "e.value", protein = "protein", q_value = 0.01, decoy = "^REV_") {
  fdr <- compute_fdr(data[[score]], grepl(decoy, data[[protein]]), larger_better = FALSE)
  cutoff <- predict_score_fdr(fdr, q_value = q_value, method = "simple_fdr")

  filt <- filter(data, .data[[score]] <= .env$cutoff)
  nDecoy <- sum(grepl(decoy, filt[[protein]]))
  nConfident <- nrow(filt) - nDecoy

  res <- data.frame(
    n = nrow(data),
    nConfident = nConfident,
    nDecoy = nDecoy,
    fdr = nDecoy / nConfident,
    assignmentRate = nrow(filt) / nrow(data) * 100
  )
  colnames(res) <- paste0(colnames(res), level)
  res
}
```

# PSM level

```{r}
summarizeLevel(bcd)
```


# Peptide FDR

Use minimum of e.value of all PSMs matching a peptide as new score for the peptide.

```{r}
peptideLevel <- bcd |>
  summarise(n = n(), min_e.value = min(e.value), .by = c(plain_peptide, protein))
```

```{r}
table(peptideLevel$n)
summarizeLevel(peptideLevel, score = "min_e.value", level = "Peptides")
```

# Protein FDR

Use minimum of e.value of all PSMs matching a protein as new score for the protein.

```{r}
proteinLevel <- bcd |>
  summarise(n = n(), min_e.value = min(e.value), .by = protein)
```

```{r}
table(proteinLevel$n)
summarizeLevel(proteinLevel, score = "min_e.value", level = "Proteins")
```

# Filter on PSM level only

Filter on PSM level and then estimate the FDR on peptide and protein level.

```{r}
filtLevel <- function(data, score = "e.value", larger_better = FALSE, protein = "protein", q_value = 0.01, decoy = "^REV_") {
  fdr <- compute_fdr(data[[score]], grepl(decoy, data[[protein]]), larger_better = larger_better)
  cutoff <- predict_score_fdr(fdr, q_value = q_value, method = "simple_fdr")
  print(cutoff)
  if (larger_better) {
    filter(data, .data[[score]] >= .env$cutoff)
  } else {
    filter(data, .data[[score]] <= .env$cutoff)
  }
}

summarizeFDRS <- function(data, filt, psmFdrCutoff, pep = "plain_peptide", prot = "protein", decoy = "^REV_") {
  res <- list()
  res$nPSM <- nrow(data)
  res$psmFdrCutoff <- psmFdrCutoff
  res$nDecoyPSM <- sum(grepl(decoy, filt[[prot]]))
  res$nConfidentPSM <- nrow(filt) - res$nDecoyPSM
  res$fdrPSM <- res$nDecoyPSM / res$nConfidentPSM

  # peptide level FDR
  filtPep <- filt |> select(all_of(c(pep, prot))) |> distinct()
  res$nDecoyPeptide <- sum(grepl(decoy, filtPep[[prot]]))
  res$nConfidentPeptide <- nrow(filtPep) - res$nDecoyPeptide
  res$fdrPeptide <- res$nDecoyPeptide / res$nConfidentPeptide

  # protein level FDR
  filtProt <- filt |> select(all_of(prot)) |> distinct()
  res$nDecoyProtein <- sum(grepl(decoy, filtProt[[prot]]))
  res$nConfidentProtein <- nrow(filtProt) - res$nDecoyProtein
  res$fdrProtein <- res$nDecoyProtein / res$nConfidentProtein
  data.frame(res)
}
```

## Use e-value

```{r}
# psm level FDR
psmFdrCutoff <- 0.01

filt <- filtLevel(bcd, score = "e.value", larger_better = FALSE, q_value = psmFdrCutoff)
knitr::kable(summarizeFDRS(bcd, filt, psmFdrCutoff))
```


## Use sp_score

```{r}
# psm level FDR
psmFdrCutoff <- 0.01

filt <- filtLevel(bcd, score = "sp_score", larger_better = TRUE, q_value = psmFdrCutoff)
knitr::kable(summarizeFDRS(bcd, filt, psmFdrCutoff))
```
